parameters.name: User-Agent
parameters.value: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0 Safari/537.36

parameters.inputSchema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"competitor": {"type": "string"}, "plans": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"name": {"type": "string"}, "price": {"type": ["number", "null"], "description": "Numeric price, null if custom/contact sales"}, "currency": {"type": "string"}, "billingPeriod": {"type": "string", "description": "e.g. monthly, annual"}, "features": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "string"}}}, "required": ["name"]}}}, "required": ["competitor", "plans"]}

parameters.query:
SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(json_build_object(
  'plan_name', plan_name, 'price', price, 'currency', currency,
  'billing_period', billing_period, 'features', features)), '[]'::json) AS baseline
FROM competitor_pricing
WHERE competitor = $1;

-- Replace the stored baseline with today's plans (skipped when nothing was extracted).
WITH del AS (
  DELETE FROM competitor_pricing
  WHERE competitor = $1 AND jsonb_array_length($2::jsonb) > 0
)
INSERT INTO competitor_pricing (competitor, plan_name, price, currency, billing_period, features)
SELECT $1,
       p->>'name',
       NULLIF(p->>'price', '')::numeric,
       p->>'currency',
       p->>'billingPeriod',
       COALESCE(p->'features', '[]'::jsonb)
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS p;
